headline: Russia Launches Massive UAV Wave; Pentagon Withholds Patriot Interceptors
subheadline: Russian reactive UAVs launched from four bases struck Zaporizhzhia and Dnipro critical infrastructure as sixty paid Patriot interceptors remain undelivered
lede: Russia launched a massive wave of reactive UAVs from Bryansk, Orel, Millerovo, and Gvardeyskoye targeting seven Ukrainian regions including Chernihiv, Kyiv, and Dnipro, killing two civilians and injuring thirty-two in Zaporizhzhia while striking Dnipro critical infrastructure causing power outages. The Pentagon is withholding approximately sixty Patriot interceptors already paid for by European allies, critically degrading Ukrainian air defense against accelerating Russian ballistic missile production. Simultaneously, Iran conducted coordinated missile and UAV launches from Omidiyeh, Behbahan, and Sarbandar in Khuzestan province with jet activity over Kermanshah and Shiraz, while Israeli strikes eliminated two senior Hamas internal security commanders in Gaza and artillery pounded southern Lebanon. A Ukrainian operation destroyed a Russian corvette near Libya, prompting Libyan condemnation, as Ukraine and Germany agreed to jointly produce thousands of reconnaissance drones by 2027.

sections.title: Massive Russian UAV Wave Hits Infrastructure
sections.body: Russian reactive UAVs launched from Bryansk, Orel, Millerovo, and Gvardeyskoye targeted seven Ukrainian regions including Chernihiv, Kyiv, and Dnipro. A strike on Zaporizhzhia killed two civilians and injured thirty-two including four children, destroying a private house and damaging a five-story building. An attack on Dnipro critical infrastructure caused explosions, power outages, and a possible railway station hit. The Pentagon is withholding approximately sixty Patriot interceptors despite European payment, suspected as leverage for territorial concessions.

sections.title: Iran Multi-Site Launches; Hamas Decapitation
sections.body: Iran launched missiles from Omidiyeh, Behbahan, and Sarbandar in Khuzestan province alongside multiple UAV launches from Omidiyeh and Behbahan, with jet activity reported over Kermanshah and Shiraz. Israeli artillery shelled Wadi al-Saluqi, Al-Mansouri, Zibqin, and Mazar'at Buyut al-Siyad in southern Lebanon with illumination bombs and warplanes over the Beqaa Valley. Israeli strikes in Gaza killed two senior Hamas internal security commanders including the chief of the apparatus and the northern Gaza director. An unexplained projectile struck a tanker fifty nautical miles west of Dubai while ISIS attacked Syrian Internal Security Forces in Al-Hasakah.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran's simultaneous missile and UAV launches from three Khuzestan sites combined with jet activity over western Iran indicate a coordinated readiness posture rather than isolated tests. Russia's massive reactive UAV campaign demonstrates sustained long-range strike capacity while the Patriot interceptor withholding critically degrades Ukrainian defenses against accelerating Russian ballistic missile production. Israeli systematic decapitation of Hamas internal security leadership alongside sustained southern Lebanon artillery pressure signals a dual-front containment strategy.
